fusions.name: Springing Jab
fusions.desc: A bounding jab that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 5 tiles.

fusions.name: Flagged Alarm
fusions.desc: Stamps the ground, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Startle Reflex
fusions.desc: Leaps you 3 tiles from where you stood and increases your dodge chance by 25% for 10 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Spooked
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (23% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
